title: Lane-speed differential (Express faster than Standard) has no direct test pin
evidence: sim_balance.gd:54 `const LANE_SPEED_MILLI := [200, 100, 60] # travel milli-units per tick, by lane (speed = priority)`; sim_core.gd:384 `pkt.progress_milli = int(pkt.progress_milli) + SimBalance.LANE_SPEED_MILLI[int(pkt.lane)]`. grep across tests/ finds zero references to LANE_SPEED; test_sim_qos's `_serialization_order_direct` pins admission ORDER (`drive(sim, 3) # credit banking may need 2+ ticks`) not traversal speed, and `_reservation_holds` bounds are admission-limited, so `[100,100,100]` would still pass.
detail: E2.4's 'strand speed = priority' is a named epic behavior; a regression to uniform lane speeds passes the entire headless suite, leaving only manual capture evidence.
recommended_fix: Add a directed test: same-length pipe, one email on Express vs one on Standard, assert Express packet's progress_milli/ticks-to-arrive strictly greater/faster.

title: HUD breach chip glue (set_breaches / _breach_lines) untested
evidence: hud.gd:56 `func set_breaches(lines: String) -> void:` and main.gd:71 `hud.set_breaches(_breach_lines())`; grep 'hud|Hud|HUD' over tests/ returns nothing (empty '=== hud refs ===' result).
detail: The player-facing SLA surface is untested glue; sim latches are fully pinned, but _breach_lines' independent-if both-latch rendering and empty-hides behavior could silently break.
recommended_fix: Unit-pin _breach_lines (both latches co-occurring produce two segments; cleared latches hide chip) in a headless test.

title: NodeSite egress pulse + cooldown (E2.4 visible serialization beat) untested
evidence:
node_site.gd:29-32 `func pulse_egress() -> void:
	if _pulse_cd > 0.0:
		return
	_pulse_cd = PULSE_COOLDOWN`; flow_view.gd:172 `func pulse_egress() -> void:` — no test references pulse_egress (grep confirmed).
detail: The node-egress visibility half of E2.4 has no headless pin; the cooldown gate and admission-driven triggering are unverified, covered only by manual captures.
recommended_fix: Headless test: admit via sim, call flow_view.pulse_egress() twice, assert second pulse suppressed inside cooldown window.

title: MAX_DOTS_PER_PIPE cap (hide overflow dots, never ghost) untested
evidence: flow_view.gd:10 `const MAX_DOTS_PER_PIPE := 48 # beyond this the density speaks; lowest ids win` and :133 `if used >= MAX_DOTS_PER_PIPE:` / `capped = true # density speaks; hide the rest — never ghost`.
detail: The density cap boundary is never exercised; a regression that ghosts or leaks pooled dots beyond 48 in-flight packets would pass the suite.
recommended_fix: Flood a pipe with >48 concurrent in-flight packets, sync, assert pool.size() == 48 and all unused slots invisible.

title: QosPanel.open unknown-pipe error path (auto-close) untested
evidence:
qos_panel.gd:116-118 `if p == null:
		close_panel()
		return` — test_view_interaction._panel_logic only opens a real pipe (`panel.open(pipe_id, sim)`); no test opens a stale/unknown id.
detail: Happy-path-only coverage of the panel's only error branch; selecting a demolished/stale pipe id could re-open a stale panel undetected.
recommended_fix: Add a leg: panel.open(9999, sim) asserts not visible and _pipe_id == -1.

title: Alloc-driven view rebuild and strand-thickness-from-share unasserted
evidence: flow_view.gd:51 `elif meta.get("alloc", []) != p.alloc:` → `_rebuild_view(id, p)`; pipe_arc.gd:24 `const HAIRLINE_FRAC := 0.3 # an unallocated lane renders as a hairline strand`, :85-89 `_strand_thickness` returns share or HAIRLINE_FRAC. No test inspects shares, _strand_thickness, or that a set_lanes command triggers a view rebuild.
detail: The primary E2.3 player feedback (strand thickness mirrors allocation) has no headless assertion; wrong shares or a dead change-detection branch would only be caught visually.
recommended_fix: After set_lanes, call flow_view.sync() and assert arc._shares equals the applied alloc and mesh was rebuilt (e.g. _pipe_meta updated).

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
evidence: test_sim_replay.gd pins replay byte-identity (plus seed-divergence and timing mutation legs); test_sim_qos.gd pins drop precedence (directed + statistical), lane reservation, gap-filling, serialization order, no-auto-alloc, deactivation guard; test_sim_sla.gd pins breach detect/attribute/sticky/isolation; test_view_purity.gd pins view-noise never shifts sim state with a negative control; test_view_interaction.gd pins select grammar (click/drag/sky), occlusion, panel payload validation, dot rebinding, strand geometry; test_editor_preview.gd pins @tool/button/guard + regenerate determinism/idempotence.
detail: P0 (all five A1 contracts): 5/5 = 100%. P1 (epic story behaviors E2.1–E2.5, select grammar, connect command path, editor preview): ~27/28 ≈ 96%. Overall including P2/P3 view glue: ~32/38 ≈ 84%. Meets PASS thresholds (P0 100%, P1 ≥90%, overall ≥80%).
recommended_fix: Optional hardening: add the lane-speed differential pin (warning above) and the P3 view-glue pins to push overall toward 95%.
